lastCompletedStory.title: Wire cam issue abandon <id> positional subcommand

nextStoryContext: All 3 stories in this PRD (US-001/US-002/US-003) now pass:true; this was the last story (CAM-210). US-003 mirrored US-002's close branch 1:1 against abandonIssueOnMain: added { mode: 'abandon'; id: string; help: false } to ParsedIssueArgs, a parse branch in parseIssueArgs (evaluated alongside list/close, before the free-text fallthrough), an IssueDispatchDeps.abandonIssueOnMainFn?: (id: string) => AbandonIssueOnMainOutcome seam defaulting to defaultAbandonIssueFn(process.cwd(), id), and a dispatchIssue branch with the same printHint/CAM_ISSUE_RESULT/exit-code shape as close. defaultAbandonIssueFn was added to src/release/post-merge.ts immediately after defaultCloseIssueFn (same real-spawnSync+clock closure convention, reusing the CloseSpawnFn type import from issue-specify.ts renamed for both close and abandon) even though runPostMerge itself never calls it -- the file is just the shared home for production default wiring around issue-specify.ts primitives. ISSUE_HELP documents 'abandon <id>' and the usage line now lists close and abandon. abandonIssueOnMain (src/commands/issue-specify.ts:409, pre-existing, untouched) already had the already-abandoned guard and full unit coverage in test/commands/issue-specify.test.ts; this story only added parse+dispatch tests in test/issue-dispatch.test.ts. Full bun run check:all is green (3653 tests, typecheck/lint/embed-vendor/coverage/dead-code/dup/ci-parity all ok). Since the PRD is now complete, the next agent invocation should find no passes:false non-operator stories and exit PRD_COMPLETE; the orchestrator should run /cam-review next.
